changes: Fixed: sheets printed with learner names now identify the learner automatically after a real printer, photocopier or phone camera thickens the tiny code-square outlines. QuickCheck uses a code-specific reading method and still refuses an unclear or conflicting code instead of risking the wrong learner.

Fixed: a clear answer-sheet photo was rejected when glare, a fold or a printer edge hid one of its four black corner squares. QuickCheck now reads safely from the other three and asks you to check it once; a photo with fewer than three still asks for a retake.

A new Check papers page: every paper waiting for you in one list, what is ready to save and what needs a look, and exactly where the scores will go — your class record, QuickCheck's copy of it, or a simple scorebook.

Sheets printed with names: QuickCheck now remembers who each sheet was printed for, so a late enrollee or a renumbered class can no longer put a paper under the wrong name. If a sheet was printed for someone no longer in the class, it asks you instead of guessing.
Absent or excused: mark a learner who did not sit the test, and they are no longer counted as missing. A make-up paper checked later clears the mark by itself.
Checking with your phone is safer: photos taken while the Wi-Fi drops wait on the phone and send themselves when the computer is back, even if you close the page.

One bar on every page of a test — Prepare, Check papers, Results — so you always know where you are. A quick quiz no longer asks about a Table of Specifications; tick the box when you want one. The menu item Check papers is now called Tests.

One clean Results page for each test: where the test stands and where the scores went, then Print or download — the Report for your principal first, with your school's header and the Noted by line — then every learner, including those absent or with no paper yet.
A score you change by hand in QuickCheck's class record is the official one. The marked paper, the Results page and the printed report now say so beside that learner.
Deleting saved photos and clearing backups moved from Results to Settings.
Easier to read: stronger colours for small text and for the Save score & next button. The photo review works from the keyboard too: + and − zoom, arrow keys move.
Settings has Make a problem report: one short file that tells us what we need to help you, with no learners' names, scores or photos in it. You see all of it before you send it.
